name: Electric toothbrushes and shavers

comps.spec: One 3.6–3.7V lithium cell (often 14500 size, some 18650) in newer models
One or two 1.2V NiMH cells in older and budget models
Small 1.2–3.7V DC motor (shavers, clippers, rotating brushes)
Neodymium magnets in the resonant drive (sonic toothbrushes)
Inductive charging stand with a coil (toothbrushes) or a small adapter

notes: Handles are sealed and often welded shut: cut or pry carefully so you don't puncture the cell.

sources.title: Open Repair Alliance, Open Repair Data v0.3 (community repair events, 2012 to July 2026; CC BY-SA 4.0): 949 repairs recorded as Hair & beauty item (electric toothbrush subset)
